title: GOOD: stoa-verify CA expiry checked during chain validation
description: stoa-verify verify_and_extract_cn() checks both the leaf certificate validity period and the issuing CA certificate validity period before accepting a chain. Most TLS libraries only check the leaf; checking the CA as well prevents accepting chains signed by an expired CA that a misconfigured peer still trusts. Correct defense-in-depth; do not remove the CA expiry check.
